operatorFailuresPreserved.failure: The restricted operator could not traverse the existing private audit parent.
operatorFailuresPreserved.resolution: Used a separate project-owned recovery directory with verified copies; did not widen the shared audit parent permissions or add an ACL.

operatorFailuresPreserved.failure: The sealed WAL-mode backup required its own WAL/SHM sidecars for a read-only SQLite open.
operatorFailuresPreserved.resolution: Created restricted sidecars beside the isolated copy; integrity_check passed, changes were zero and the backup SHA-256 remained identical.
